articles.title: Puja Khedkar Row Deepens: Mother Manorama Booked for Obstructing Police in Kidnap Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pune: The controversy around former IAS trainee Puja Khedkar has taken another turn. Pune City Police have booked her mother, Manorama Khedkar, for allegedly obstructing Navi Mumbai police during the rescue of a truck driver in a kidnapping case.

body.html:
Pune: The controversy around former IAS trainee Puja Khedkar has taken another turn. Pune City Police have booked her mother, Manorama Khedkar, for allegedly obstructing Navi Mumbai police during the rescue of a truck driver in a kidnapping case.

Police said a mixer truck had collided with a car near Airoli, Navi Mumbai. After the crash, two men allegedly abducted the truck driver’s helper, Prahlad Kumar, and took him to Puja Khedkar’s Pune residence. When police tracked the vehicle and reached the house, Manorama allegedly blocked their entry and tried to shield the accused. She has been charged under Sections 221, 238, and 263 of the BNS and summoned for questioning.

Prahlad Kumar was later rescued safely.

This comes after Puja Khedkar was sacked from IAS in 2023, with UPSC cancelling her selection for allegedly misusing OBC and disability quotas and banning her for life from civil services exams.

articles.title: Class 12 Girl Electrocuted to Death at Family’s Under-Construction Home
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: GORAKHPUR: In a devastating incident, an 18-year-old girl was electrocuted to death on Sunday while inspecting her family's under-construction new home in the Moghalha area. The deceased, identified as Sakshi alias Pragya, was a Class 12 student.

body.html:
GORAKHPUR: In a devastating incident, an 18-year-old girl was electrocuted to death on Sunday while inspecting her family's under-construction new home in the Moghalha area. The deceased, identified as Sakshi alias Pragya, was a Class 12 student.

According to reports, Sakshi had accompanied her mother, Shashibala Maurya, a government school teacher, and her younger brother to the construction site. While her mother was on the ground floor, Sakshi went to the second-floor roof. Officials from the electricity department stated that while using her mobile phone and peering down from the railing, she came into contact with an open live electric wire passing near the house.

Upon hearing shouts from passersby who witnessed the accident, her mother rushed to the roof. Bystanders managed to separate Sakshi from the wire using a plastic pipe, but she had already succumbed to her injuries. She was pronounced dead at the scene.

The tragedy has left the family shattered. Shashibala Maurya, a widow who lost her husband years ago, is now inconsolable after losing her daughter. She described Sakshi as her primary support in life and all responsibilities. The family also includes an 11-year-old son, Shreyansh.

Police from the Gulriha police station responded to the incident and sent the body to BRD Medical College for a postmortem. The electricity department has cut power to the area and launched an investigation into the exposed wiring.

articles.title: Kanpur Police Shame Molester, Force Him to Parade with Apology Placard
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: KANPUR: In a unique punishment, the Kanpur Police on Saturday arrested and publicly shamed a man who molested and assaulted a minor girl. The accused, identified as Yash, was apprehended near his residence in Saket Nagar for the September 8th incident in Kidwai Nagar.

body.html:
KANPUR: In a unique punishment, the Kanpur Police on Saturday arrested and publicly shamed a man who molested and assaulted a minor girl. The accused, identified as Yash, was apprehended near his residence in Saket Nagar for the September 8th incident in Kidwai Nagar.

According to reports, the Class 11 student was returning from her coaching centre when Yash, accompanied by 8-10 friends, stopped her, held her hand, and tried to force her to walk with him. When she protested, he slapped her three times and spat on her. When other students from the coaching centre intervened, they were also beaten by Yash's group.

The victim's mother, a widow and resident of Juhi Colony, filed a police complaint on Friday. She stated that Yash had been harassing her daughter for the past three years.

After his arrest, the accused begged for forgiveness, reportedly telling police, "Sir, forgive me, from today I will consider every girl as my mother and sister." In response, the police made him wear a placard with the same apology written on it. He was then paraded around the police station premises with folded hands and was seen limping during the act.

DCP Dipendra Nath Chaudhary confirmed the arrest and stated that a video of this unusual punishment was made to "teach him a lesson." A case has been registered against the accused.

articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a dramatic late-night chase, Tirupati Alipiri police arrested notorious rowdy sheeter Azim and his aide Bablu for kidnapping a 27-year-old married woman, Supriya, and her mother.

body.html:
In a dramatic late-night chase, Tirupati Alipiri police arrested notorious rowdy sheeter Azim and his aide Bablu for kidnapping a 27-year-old married woman, Supriya, and her mother.

Police said Azim had coerced Supriya into a relationship and, after she tried to end it, lured her to meet him on Friday. At knife-point, Azim and Bablu forced Supriya and her mother into a car.

Supriya managed to send her live location to her husband, who alerted police. Acting swiftly, CI Ram Kishore pursued Azim, who rammed into several vehicles while fleeing, before being caught on the outskirts of Tirupati.

Both women were rescued safely. Cases of kidnapping, attempt to murder, and other serious charges have been registered.

In Varanasi, a shocking case has surfaced where advocate Shiv Pratap Singh was allegedly assaulted by Inspector Crime Gopal Kanhaiya at Rathyatra intersection under Bhelupur police station limits.

The dispute began when the inspector stopped Singh’s vehicle, citing no-entry amid traffic chaos caused by heavy rain. The altercation turned violent, leaving the advocate with serious injuries. He was rushed to BHU Trauma Center, where his treatment continues.

The incident occurred while Singh was returning home with his wife, Sharda Singh, after visiting Maa Lakshmi. Following her complaint, a case of attempted murder has been registered against the inspector.

A large group of lawyers gathered at the trauma center demanding strict action. Police officials have confirmed an investigation and assured action against those found guilty. The incident has triggered massive outrage in the legal fraternity.

articles.title: Supreme Court Order Turns Deadly: UP Teachers Ends his Live Over TET Pressure
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Uttar Pradesh is reeling under shock after government teachers allegedly committed suicide following the Supreme Court’s order making the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) mandatory for all teachers. In Mahoba district, 52-year-old government teacher Manoj Sahu was found hanging in his home.

body.html:
Uttar Pradesh is reeling under shock after government teachers allegedly committed suicide following the Supreme Court’s order making the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) mandatory for all teachers.

In Mahoba district, 52-year-old government teacher Manoj Sahu was found hanging in his home. He had secured his job under the deceased dependent quota after his father’s death. Troubled by the thought of clearing TET at this age, he reportedly ended his life.

A similar incident surfaced in Hamirpur district, where Ganeshilal, posted as an assistant teacher at an upper primary school in Mahoba, died by suicide at his second residence in Atraulia. His son, Anuragi, revealed that his father had been under immense stress ever since the Supreme Court ruling. He was worried about losing his job if he failed to clear the exam.

The apex court recently ruled that all government teachers with more than five years of service left must clear TET to retain their jobs or secure promotions. Those with less than five years of service are exempt. The decision has sparked fear and resentment among thousands of teachers in the state.

The tragic deaths of Manoj Sahu and Ganeshilal highlight the growing anxiety among government teachers, who now face the pressure of examinations despite decades of service.

articles.title: Gonda CMO Sparks Outrage with ‘Laddus’ Remark After Death of Newborns
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gonda, Uttar Pradesh – A major controversy erupted after Chief Medical Officer (CMO) Dr. Rashmi Verma made a shocking remark while responding to the deaths of two newborns at an unregistered private nursing home. In a video that has gone viral, Dr.

body.html:
Gonda, Uttar Pradesh – A major controversy erupted after Chief Medical Officer (CMO) Dr. Rashmi Verma made a shocking remark while responding to the deaths of two newborns at an unregistered private nursing home.

In a video that has gone viral, Dr. Verma is seen laughing and saying: “One newborn died and everyone is after me. Thousands are alive. Go, eat some laddus.” The comment, made during a media interaction, has been widely condemned for its insensitivity.

The incident took place at a nursing home operating without registration, where two infants died within an hour. Families alleged negligence, leading to protests and the immediate sealing of the facility by health authorities.

Following the backlash, Dr. Verma defended herself, claiming her words were taken “out of context,” edited, and spread in a misleading way. She insisted the video was not meant to hurt sentiments and stressed that she stands with the grieving families.

She explained that she was overwhelmed by repeated questions from journalists and had only intended to highlight the balance between frequent healthy births and rare complications—not to belittle the tragedy.

Meanwhile, the health department has sealed the nursing home and launched a formal investigation into the deaths. Dr. Verma stated that strict action will be taken against those found guilty of negligence and assured that medical violations will not be tolerated.

It is worth noting that Dr. Verma has previously faced accusations of corruption and misconduct from local legislators, though those claims are separate from the current controversy.

Her remark has drawn sharp criticism from citizens, politicians, and civil society groups, who argue that a senior health officer must show empathy and responsibility in times of tragedy.

articles.title: Murder Twist: Arvind Accuses Nandini & Boyfriend of False Case, Property Grab Plot
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, witnessed a chilling crime on September 12, when a man shot his live-in partner dead in broad daylight outside Roop Singh Stadium and streamed the act live on Facebook. The accused, Arvind Thakur, a contractor, has been arrested.

body.html:
Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, witnessed a chilling crime on September 12, when a man shot his live-in partner dead in broad daylight outside Roop Singh Stadium and streamed the act live on Facebook.

The accused, Arvind Thakur, a contractor, has been arrested. He fired 3–5 bullets at Nandini Kewat (also known as Parihar) at point-blank range after stopping her car near the busy stadium. Following the shooting, Arvind sat beside the body, brandishing his pistol and daring anyone to intervene. Police eventually overpowered him after firing tear gas shells.

Investigations have revealed a disturbing background. Arvind was already married to two women, while Nandini, reportedly in her fifth relationship, had a criminal history. In 2017, she was jailed for four-and-a-half years for murdering her third husband with the help of another lover in Datia, before being released in 2022.

Arvind and Nandini had secretly married at an Arya Samaj temple, despite both being already married. Their relationship soon turned violent, with multiple cases of assault, blackmail, and property disputes filed against each other.

Nandini had accused Arvind of sharing obscene videos, assaulting her with the help of another woman, and even attempting to run over her family. She had also demanded a share in his property. Just days before her death, on September 9, she lodged fresh complaints against him.

Arvind, in his Facebook live stream before the murder, accused Nandini of betrayal, blackmail, and attempts to seize his property. Police continue to investigate the chain of violence, deception, and revenge that culminated in this killing.

Date & Location: September 12, 2025 | Outside Roop Singh Stadium, Gwalior
Accused: Arvind Thakur (contractor, estranged partner)
Victim: Nandini Kewat (28/32, history of live-in relationships & legal conflicts) Nandini declared dead at JAH Hospital; Arvind arrested
